stories.title: Lanning decries USC's 'disgusting' hit after Ducks' Moore knocked out of game
stories.summary: Oregon quarterback Dante Moore was carted off the field after a late hit by USC linebacker Desman Stephens II that Ducks coach Dan Lanning ripped as a "disgusting play."

stories.title: Sources: Bears QB Williams considered to have 3-4 week injury timeline
stories.summary: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams has a Grade 2 hamstring injury that doctors say could sideline him for three to four weeks, league sources told ESPN and NFL Network.
